value.mission: Develop robotic prospecting and extraction systems for asteroid resources.
value.business_model: Earn aerospace engineering, instrument-development, and mission-analysis revenue while developing asteroid resource technology.

value.boilerplate: AstroDig LLC is an aerospace engineering company based in Boulder, Colorado. Founded in 2013, the company develops mission-analysis tools, robotic prospecting instruments, and controlled extraction test systems. Its long-term objective is an asteroid resource demonstration by 2032, subject to technical, financial, and mission-readiness gates.
